scripts.migration:run: npm run build && typeorm -d dist/data-source.js migration:run
scripts.migration:revert: npm run build && typeorm -d dist/data-source.js migration:revert
scripts.test:admin: npm run build && node --test test/admin-security.test.cjs test/admin-reports.integration.cjs && tsx --test test/admin-notifications.test.ts
scripts.test:admin:integration: npm run build && node test/run-admin-integration.cjs all
scripts.test:admin-security:integration: npm run build && node test/run-admin-integration.cjs security
scripts.test:admin-reports:integration: npm run build && node test/run-admin-integration.cjs reports
scripts.test:admin-notifications:integration: npm run build && node test/run-admin-integration.cjs notifications
